name: Ruaha National Park
intro: Ruaha National Park is one of Tanzania’s largest and most remarkable national parks, offering an authentic African safari in the heart of the southern circuit. Dominated by the life-giving Great Ruaha River, the park supports one of East Africa’s largest elephant populations and a rich diversity of wildlife. Its landscapes rolling hills, rocky escarpments, expansive savannahs, and majestic baobab trees create a breathtaking backdrop for adventure, photography, and nature exploration.

The park is ideal for wildlife enthusiasts seeking a remote and uncrowded safari experience. Visitors can encounter lions, leopards, cheetahs, buffaloes, giraffes, and the rare African wild dog in their natural habitat. With vast open spaces, dramatic scenery, and exceptional biodiversity, Ruaha National Park offers a peaceful, exclusive, and unforgettable safari adventure in Tanzania’s southern wilderness.
